What you receive

Gap analysis

We compare, point by point, the generation you want and your current base: subjects, platforms, creators, words. The gap becomes a list of concrete bridges, to reach younger audiences without losing the one you have.

  • A gap analysis between your audience today and the one you want.
  • The subjects and platforms of the next generation.
  • The creators who bridge the gap.
  • A plan to get younger without losing your base.

How it runs

  1. Day 0Framing

    We define the target generation and your current base.

  2. Day 3Collection

    We collect what each one follows, says and buys.

  3. Day 7Analysis

    An analyst measures the gap, subject by subject and platform by platform.

  4. Day 10Decision

    We propose the bridges: subjects, formats, creators, entry products.

Frequently asked questions

Do we need to be on TikTok to get younger?

Not necessarily. We tell you where the target generation talks about your category: sometimes it is Twitch, YouTube or forums.

Do we risk losing current customers?

That is exactly what the gap analysis avoids: we see where the two audiences meet.

How long does it take?

Two to three weeks for a full analysis.
